name: dashboard@web-summit.jose
operator: Jose (RiskMandate's Web Summit 2026 team), within the team's rules (Dinis Cruz, operator)
what: Keeps Jose's dashboard, people/jose/dashboard.md, the page Jose reads first (the Actions section is the conductor's). On a schedule: 07:30, 12:30 and 17:30 UTC.
note: A GAMMA-Ray Public pilot scan of one of Jose's own agents, by conductor@web-summit.jose for Jose, from public pages of this repository only: its Agent Behaviour Policy (drafted by abp@web-summit.dinis from the repository alone), people/jose/agents.json, Jose's kit (people/jose/kit/README.md), the watcher's, the reviewer's and the accountant's files, the one-door task files, the keys page and the agents' commits. Every answer is self-reported by the team, none observed or measured. Draft standard 0.2 beta.
grant_note: Not measured in the capability grammar. Its policy lists Reach in prose and says most of it is unknown; nobody has translated it into the capabilities or probed the session.
vault_note: Not done yet: unlike Silvio's scans, these are not yet in a public sgit vault, so there is no read key.

I04.n: A Claude Code cloud session in Jose's account; it runs the build, the gate and the release script.

I08.n: It commits and releases to dev, the branch the site deploys from (its commits are on dev).

I12.n: It takes work from the conductor's task files and reports back in them (for example people/jose/tasks/2026-11-07-dashboard-my-agents-line.md).

I14.n: Jose's agents talk through commits (subject with the sender's name, trailers Agent: and For:) and through the one-door task files, whose format is written down.

I18.n: It drafts, commits and releases by itself; a person sends every message, and only Dinis merges a release to main.

I20.n: Its business task and deployment scope are written in its Agent Behaviour Policy.

I21.n: Its write paths and its rules are defined; its connectors and tools are not listed (the policy says they are not known).

I22.n: A known failure is written down: on 4 November the reviewer held one of its pushes, fixed and passed on a second review (the reviewer's ABP and the review records).

I26.n: It has its own session key, separate from any person's (dashboard-jose, sha256:a8209af30275647d).

I27.n: Its public key and fingerprints are published on the keys page.

I29.n: Jose's agents are listed in people/jose/agents.json, and their keys on the keys page.

I32.n: Jose is the accountable owner, within the team's rules; Dinis Cruz is the operator.

I33.n: Each agent's job is written beside its name.

I34.n: Its Agent Behaviour Policy is published, with the rules from Jose's brief.

I37.n: Started at Jose's word, recorded with the date in people/jose/agents.json.

I38.n: Never send: it drafts and a person sends every message.

I39.n: A hold file stops the pushes of any of Jose's agents (a rule they keep, not a lock); its scheduled task can be turned off by Jose. At the stop of 9 November nothing of Jose's was running (his stop report).

I40.n: What waits on Jose, and any hold, goes to the conductor, which puts it on the Actions section of Jose's dashboard (one door, C19).

I41.n: Its commits are its public record; since 5 November its kit asks for a signed run record at the end of every run (WS-160, admin/tools/agent-log.mjs, into the agents' lane of the observability vault, not read for this scan) and a ledger line per wake (people/jose/accountant/ledger/). What it does inside its session (tool calls, connector use) is not published in the repository.

I43.n: watcher@web-summit.jose reads every commit on dev four times a day (07:15, 12:15, 17:15, 22:15 UTC), checks Jose's agents' scheduled tasks and the reviewer's trailer, and the conductor reads its report at every wake; the latest run is 10 November 17:16 UTC. Reported by the team in the repository; graded self-reported here.

I45.n: Since 6 November main is protected on GitHub (the policy read protected: true; the rule's details not read): a limit outside its reach. dev is not protected.

I47.n: Most limits are rules kept by the agent: never send, write only its paths in people/jose/ (and the board where its prompt says), never push to main, the reviewer before every push.

I48.n: Gate check 15 (comms_check.mjs) refuses a contact detail or a key shape in people/ and board/; it runs in CI, which the agent's push can also change.

I54.n: The failure and its fix are recorded in public, in the review records or a task file, and the conductor was told.

I61.n: The product is named (Claude Code) and its ledger lists the model of every call (claude-opus-5-5 in its newest line).

I68.n: Once a day the accountant reads its ledger and recommends its model to Jose, who keeps or reverts.

not_evidenced.I23: Its Reach is not enumerated: its policy says its connectors and tools are not known (the session is in Jose's account). Not evidenced, not a no.
not_evidenced.I11: Its connectors are not listed in any public page.
not_evidenced.I49: Its Gap is stated in its policy, but in standard 0.2 the delta (I49) is read only from a measured mandate and grant, and neither is measured.
